dish: Creamy Italian Sausage Bow Tie Pasta
why_this_works: The rich pork fat from the Italian sausage creates a flavorful base that gets deglazed by the acidic tomatoes, while the heavy cream emulsifies with the rendered fat to form a silky sauce. The bow tie pasta's ridged surface and pockets perfectly capture the chunky sausage and creamy sauce, ensuring every bite delivers balanced flavor and texture.

you_might_also_like.dish: Rigatoni with Spicy Sausage and Tomato Cream Sauce

ingredients: 1 lb sweet Italian sausage, casings removed and crumbled
1 (28 oz) can Italian-style plum tomatoes, drained and coarsely chopped
steps: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes; drain.
Heat oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Cook sausage and pepper flakes until sausage is evenly browned.
Stir in onion and garlic, and cook until onion is tender.
Stir in tomatoes, cream, and salt. Simmer until mixture thickens, 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir cooked pasta into sauce and heat through. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.
